text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival. To show
gratitude for everyday support, fans are invited onto campus
to enjoy various sports-themed events.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, K.S.Miracle was playing
volleyball with her classmates—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Osheeeeeey!
We are number ooooone!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Eeee~~~~~!!
Heli-chan is the best ever~~~~~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what immense cheering!
Looks like quite a few of my fans showed up too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to show you what I've got~!
Who would've thought I'd actually win, though?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I had a feeling I might be good at it♪
There are quite a few girls who are like, 'Races are one thing, but other sports are...', but—"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"We've got plenty of athletic girls on our side!
We even have Ryan-chan, the super service ace, right~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You were great too, Ines! That serve was super powerful! I could practically feel your biceps pulsating...!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Palmer and Helios's teamwork was wonderful too, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Palmer's tosses and Helios's spikes,
almost all of them scored, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, that too!!
However—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I kneeeew it, Miracle's the absolute best!!
Miracle is totally unrivaleeeed~~!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, me?
I didn't score a single point, though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No way, she saved SO many balls, right?!
She was seriously a god-tier libero!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You're always so good at backing me up~.
Sweet little Mira-pippi, *luuuv* ya♡

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Helios... hehe, I see.
If I was able to help, that makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text: Miracleeee!! I saw you, that was amazingggg!!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text: I'll come cheer for you in the next race too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The events K.S. Miracle participated in safely concluded,
having been a roaring success—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
Sorry to keep you waiting."
choice_data_list: Good work! Congrats on winning the volleyball match.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
Oh, right, you came to the gym, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I found it along the way...
Fufu, it made me break into a smile.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um, my events are all done, so...
Shall we take our time looking around a bit?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: If we run into any fans along the way, I was thinking... it'd be nice to give them some fan service.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hold it right thereee!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You can't do that, Miracle-saaaan!!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
B-Bakushin O?
What's the matter...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Unacceptable! Yes, completely unacceptable!
For someone who intends to compete for the fastest with me!!
To say they're taking it "easy" and "laid-back"?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Anytime, anywhere, even at the Fan Appreciation Festival,
we are all about Speed!!
We must live for Speed!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right this way!!
Bakushin, bakushiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Uh, wait...?
choice_data_list: Should we try following along for now...?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O & Biko
text_block_list.text:
"‘Speed Is the Deciding Factor!
Rooftop Appeal Contest’~~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple!!
The start is the 1st floor school entrance!!
The goal is the rooftop doorway!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If you sprint all the way up within the time limit, it's appeal time on the rooftop!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's shout out all our feelings
to all our fans and rivals with everything we've got!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: If time runs out, you won't get to make your appeal, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "On the flip side, the faster you cross the goal line, the more appeal time you get~♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Calling all Umamusume who pride themselves on speed!
Walk-ins are more than welcome~♪

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's Miracle...! 
Wait, wait? Is she gonna do an impromptu performance for us?!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Hey, shh...!!
What if we end up forcing them?!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, I'd definitely be thrilled if she ran, but still!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see... Yeah. Since Bakushin O
went out of her way to invite me and all...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Would it be okay if I went?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
Our walk-in participant, K.S.Miracle-san,
are you ready to go~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Akebono-san and I will be your cute commentators today~♪
Now then—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san, it's time to start!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san is already passing the 2nd floor~!!
That's the fastest pace so far~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!
We might just set a new record here!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, if you're curious about how she runs,
make sure to check out the stream archive on
Tracers' Academy's official UmaTube channel too♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Now, just one more flight of stairs to go~!!
Miracle-san bursts into a sudden sprint!!
She's so fast, so faaast!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh...!
Miracle-san, I knew you were...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The finish line is right ahead!! Fans, lend me your cheers, pleaaase!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!!
Do your best, Miracleeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Gooooal!!
Great work out there, Miracle-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All right, the results are...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, so close! No new record...!
But that was crazy fast, so you've got
plenty of time to make your appeal!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'll be the one to give the signal when it's over!
Go get 'em, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thanks, Biko.
I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, I'm feeling a little nervous.
Let's see—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
To all the fans who cheered for me:
Thank you so very much, always.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, K.S.Miracle offered her thanks
with simple yet earnest words,
captivating the hearts of her fans.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible, it's a new record!!
Senpai, you just scored the longest appeal time ever!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and chat with them all you want!
When time's up,
I'll give you a signal!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
Thanks, Biko. I'm off!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um, do I stand here...?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Wah... I can see everyone's faces
a lot better than I expected. Are the ones waving at me...
my fans? I'm so grateful.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (And then... Ah.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey Miracleee~!!
Looks like you're having stupidly crazy fun?!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Helios! And our classmates, plus Bamboo... Ah, Ruby and Zephyr too.
Did she bring everyone along?)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
First of all, to everyone who cheered for me...
thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think there were times I made you worry, but...
I'm okay now. ...I'm completely fine.

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!!
Uuuughhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's so great. ...Really great!
I'm gonna keep cheering you on from now on too--!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I will definitely... live up to the cheers I've received.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And everyone else!
All my classmates who are so nice to me...
Everyone who runs with me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Thank you so much, as always. For the fun, the passion, and the things that warm my heart so gently..."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "I'm always receiving so much from everyone. ...I wonder if I'm properly giving back."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little worried, but... still.
I'd be really happy if we could stay together from now on, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing K.S.Miracle give a shy smile, her friends each erupted in excitement.
And after that—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: And then, lastly—...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Miracle-san?
...Miracle-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There's still time to appeal to the crowd!
Go ahead, shout out your honest feelings!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With K.S. Miracle remaining dead silent,
the surrounding crowd begins to stir. Is he okay?
He doesn't seem troubled or looking down, but—
choice_data_list: (I mean, we've been making eye contact this whole time, but—)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aaah...! Sorry, Senpai!
Time's up...!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
! ...No.
Thanks for letting me know, Biko.
I'm heading back downstairs.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Still, though, are you sure about this?
Didn't you want to say something at the end...?”

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay.
Even if I think about it over and over, probably—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't put it into words.
...Because I feel like I wasn't able to truly get it across.
